desc:
🎨 PAINT CHAMELEON 🎨

Copy any color, blend into the map., and don't get found.

🖌️ PAINT — Click any surface to copy its color onto your body!
🦎 BLEND — Freeze, pose, and vanish into the map!
🃏 OUTSMART — Spawn a Clone and watch the Seeker waste their time!
🏆 SURVIVE — Outlast the round, earn coins, and unlock 24 guns, spins, and rewards!

Will you blend in... or get SPLATTED? ☠️👀
✨ Like & Favorite if you enjoyed — updates every week!
